gizmo.title: Layli xisaabeed
gizmo.description: Taxane gaaban oo masalooyin xisaabeed la sameeyay oo leh jawaab-celin degdeg ah. Dooro hawlgallada iyo xadka tirooyinka; mar kasta waa cusub.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Magaca laylisan, oo ka muuqda madaxiisa.

configure.title: Hawlgallada
configure.description: Noocyada masalooyinka la weydiiyo. Ardaydu way demin karaan mid kasta ka hor intaysan bilaabin.

configure.title: Tirada ugu yar
configure.description: Tirada ugu yar ee masalada lagu isticmaalo. Tirooyin dhan, 0 ama ka badan.

configure.title: Tirada ugu weyn
configure.description: Tirada ugu weyn ee masalada lagu isticmaalo. Jawaabaha qaybinta iyo qaybiyeyaashuna waxay ku jiraan xadkan.

configure.title: Tirada masalooyinka
configure.description: Immisa masalo ayaa ku jira hal mar (1 ilaa 100).

advanced.title: Xadka waqtiga
advanced.description: Ilbiriqsiyada loo oggol yahay hal mar oo dhan. 0 macnaheedu waa saacad la'aan, taasoo caadi ah: laylisyada waqtiga leh waxay guuldarreeyaan ardayda u baahan waqti dheeraad ah. Marka la dejiyo, ardaydu weli way demin karaan saacadda.

advanced.title: Midabka xoojinta
advanced.description: Midabka chip-ka madaxa iyo badhamada. Ka tag madhan si aad u raacdo theme-ka.
